original_row.title: Not every compact set is conformally removable
original_row.axiom_use: Assume AC for the round-circle and positive-area removability suppliers. Countable Choice is used by the Lebesgue product and measure interfaces for the planar fat-Cantor example; it follows from AC by [[thm-choice-implies-dependent-implies-countable-choice]]. The explicit radial counterexample is choice free.
original_row.statement:
Assume the Axiom of Choice ([[def-axiom-of-choice]]). The closed unit disk $\overline{\mathbb D}:=\{z\in\mathbb C:|z|\le1\}$ is a compact set that is not globally conformally removable ([[def-conformal-removable-compact-set]]). A witness is the sphere map
$$F(z)=\begin{cases}z(1+|z|)/2,&|z|\le1,\\z,&|z|\ge1,\end{cases}\qquad F(\infty)=\infty.$$
It fixes $\mathbb S^1:=\{z:|z|=1\}$ pointwise and is conformal on $\widehat{\mathbb C}\setminus\overline{\mathbb D}$, while it is not Möbius. The boundary $\mathbb S^1$ is conformally removable ([[lem-round-circles-are-conformally-removable]]).

More generally, every compact sphere set with positive planar area in the finite chart is not conformally removable ([[lem-positive-area-compact-sets-are-not-conformally-removable]]). Such examples need not have interior: the product of two positive-length Smith–Volterra–Cantor sets is a compact positive-area set with empty interior.

There are also nonremovable Jordan curves of zero area: Bishop's flexible-curve theorem yields one with zero two-dimensional Hausdorff measure and hence zero planar area. This comparison is not needed for the explicit disk witness.
original_row.strategy: Preserve the local radial disk and fat-Cantor positive-area witnesses. For the retained zero-area Jordan comparison, cite only Bishop Theorem2 and its following existence paragraph under the exact recorded owner authority; prove the radius-gauge to library Hausdorff2 and planar-area conversion locally in Proof3.1.

references.title: Mikhail Lyubich, Conformal Geometry and Dynamics of Quadratic Polynomials, vol. I (book draft, Stony Brook)
references.locator: Ch. 2 §16.1–16.2, printed p. 215: Definition 16.1, the statement that smooth Jordan curves are classically removable, and Proposition 16.4 on positive-area removability. Lyubich's Definition 16.1 is neighborhood-local; this item uses the separately stated global CH definition and proves its disk witness directly. Read in full.

references.title: Malik Younsi, On removable sets for holomorphic functions, EMS Surveys in Mathematical Sciences 2 (2015), 219–254
references.locator: §4.2, Proposition 4.4 and Remark 4.5, printed p. 235: positive-area compact sets are not CH-removable by the measurable Riemann mapping theorem; §5.2, Theorem 5.17, printed pp. 244–245: Bishop's nonremovable zero-area Jordan-curve theorem and the survey's proof sketch. The proof details are checked against Bishop's original article below. Read in full.

references.title: Christopher J. Bishop, Some homeomorphisms of the sphere conformal off a curve, Annales Academiæ Scientiarum Fennicæ Mathematica 19 (1994), 323–338
references.locator: Theorem 2, printed p. 324, and its construction in §§3–4, printed pp. 330–334: for each gauge h(t)=o(t), the construction yields a non-Möbius sphere homeomorphism conformal off a Jordan curve Γ with Λ_h(Γ)=0. Taking h(t)=t² gives a nonremovable Jordan curve of zero area. Exact original-source existence input under the owner-recorded last-resort authorization; its conformal approximation/filling and limiting-boundary injectivity construction is not reproduced locally. All 16 pages, printed pp. 323–338, read in full; gauge definition printed p. 326.

proof_scope.local: Disk witness, circle comparison, positive-area obstruction, fat-Cantor example, and the radius-cover deduction of zero Hausdorff measure and planar area.
proof_scope.original_citation: Only Bishop's per-gauge flexible Jordan-curve existence and the following paragraph's separate Jordan-curve/non-Möbius conformal-off-curve existence, Theorem 2 and following paragraph, printed p. 324. Used under the exact owner-recorded last-resort authorization; the approximation/filling and limiting-homeomorphism construction is not reproduced locally.
